items.title: Nucor (NUE) Stock May Be 37% Undervalued On Cash Flow
items.summary: Nucor has seen its stock climb sharply over the past few years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are really paying for today. With the current share price at US$260.68, the key issue is whether the company’s cash flows are enough to support that level. Over the past 5 years, Nucor has delivered a 188.9% total return.
